description: Use this to set up a new loop or a stream for a scene. The stream is created empty and CANNOT start until it has (1) a destination — add_stream_destination with one from list_destinations, or get_connection_hints for how to make one — plus (2) either a playable video playlist (at least one item) or an attached published scene (set_stream_scene). Creating a stream also creates its two empty playlists (one video, one audio): for a loop, find them with list_playlists(streamId) and fill them with apply_playlist_operations — a playlist loop needs nothing published before the first start. Media facts (duration, sound) of an upload arrive about 15-25 s after it completes: a start right after uploading can be refused (state invalid) until then. When it runs is schedule_stream's job. Returns the new stream under createStream: id (stream_...), name, state, quality, framerate, createdAt.

framerate.description: Frames per second the stream is sent at.

quality.description: Output resolution sent to every destination; the account's preferred quality when omitted.

runBackupStream.description: Also publish to YouTube's backup ingest for redundancy. Doubles the streaming cost while live.

storageBackend.description: Media storage: standard (included) or large, for big playlists, billed per GiB-month.

streamDuration.description: Stop after this many seconds of streaming; 0 = run until stopped.
